notes: 6-channel, 1U (19"W x 1.75"H x 5.5"D) rack-mount headphone distribution amplifier/mixer. Two global stereo mix buses (Mix A, Mix B) feed all 6 channels, each with separate balanced 1/4" TRS Left/Right input jacks (4 jacks total for A+B). Each of the 6 channels additionally has its own rear-panel "Stereo Ext. In" (1/4" TRS, unbalanced, for a third/local source) and its own "Stereo Out" (1/4" TRS line-level copy of that channel's headphone mix) plus a front-panel 1/4" TRS headphone jack. Talkback section has a balanced XLR mic input plus a 1/4" TS external footswitch control jack. Power is via IEC inlet; sources disagree on whether voltage selection is a factory-set switch (115V/230V) or auto-sensing (100-240V) — this does not affect the port list. PreSonus's own product page (presonus.com) returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited) on every attempt and could not be fetched directly; B&H, Sweetwater, Crutchfield, and zZounds all returned 403 to automated fetch. Port list and labels were corroborated against the official PreSonus HP60 owner's manual (v1.1, rear-panel/back-panel-layout sections) as hosted on manualslib.com, in addition to the Studiocare retailer spec table used as sourceUrl.
